deviations.D1: Deviation D1: the 24-month window counts only KEV additions whose CVE was published 2021 or later (assigner is joined from vulnerabilities.csv rows published 2021+, as in the harness all-history feature); older KEV CVEs added inside the window are not counted. Did not affect the selection (C1 uses the all-history feature).

notes.seed_sets: seed set s: text OOF folds seed s, HGB random_state s (single fit, early_stopping=False). Baselines are deterministic (one 'seed').
notes.ci95_seed0: percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 0, on the seed-set-0 scores; same resamples for every model in a fold
notes.paired_bootstrap: selected model minus exploit-then-EPSS, run once per seed set (same resamples for every run); seed_median is the element-wise median over the 5 runs (each number its own median), seed_set_0 kept for reference
notes.unseen_assigner: computed per seed set; seed_median is the element-wise median, seed_set_0 kept for reference
notes.permutation: model seed set 0 for every shuffle
notes.c3: StandardScaler + sklearn LogisticRegression defaults (L2, C=1.0, no class weight), max_iter=5000; epss_f replaced by epss0 (blank=0) + epss_missing
notes.asg24: KEV rows (CVE published 2021+, as in the all-history feature) added in [month start - 24 months, month start); rate = count / (CVEs published in the same window + 20); assigners with KEV rows but no CVE published in the window get count / 20
notes.plus_structured: cvss3 score (blank 0 + indicator), one-hot of the 8 CVSS vector fields and top-40 first CWE, vocabularies fitted on train rows only
notes.masking: harness EXPLOIT_WORDING replaced by a space (case-insensitive) in train and test descriptions before TF-IDF
